questions.q: STAR #3: which line is the Task?
options: First, I pushed for a working definition…
My task was to build a defensible evidence base…
As a result, I delivered a baseline analysis…
questions.explain: T = your job. 'First…' is A, 'As a result…' is R.

I stayed neutral and kept written notes of what we agreed.
I just waited for a final decision.
